messages:
Maya K: Final dress rehearsal — starting simulated user traffic at 10% for 15m in 30m. Goal: validate rollback/rollforward, observe p95 and error rate, confirm release notes & pins. Checklist:
- Canary pinned to v2.4.1-canary (deploy-bot)
- Release notes published (Sara)
- Model quantization pins checked (Tom)
- Ops oncall watching infra
Ping owners, comment if you need to opt out.

Liam: On it. I'll capture p50/p95/p99, error rate, and redis cache hitrate. Will post dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary v2.4.1-canary -> pool-A. Instance ids: i-canary-42. Canary routing set to 10% (will adjust on request).

Sara: Release notes link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.4.1-canary -- final text ready. Feature flags: feature.chat-streaming=on, feature.embed-quant=off for canary.

ops-oncall: Ready. I have rollback playbook and quick commands prepped. If error rate >0.5% or p95 > +300ms above baseline for 5m, I'll trigger rollback. Rolling back uses:
```
# rollback to v2.4.0
deploy-bot rollback --service inference --version v2.4.0 --reason "canary fail"
```
I'll also pre-arm the circuit breaker for route /api/generate.

Tom: Quick note — embeddings model pin (embed-alpha) must stay at q8_default for Dedicated customers during canary. Please add to pin list.

Maya K: Added. Pin list: v2.4.1-canary, embed-alpha:q8_default. No further model changes during the 15m run.

ci-bot: smoke tests: 24/24 passed. Sample logs:
```
[smoke] GET /health -> 200
[smoke] generate latency median 150ms
```

ops-oncall: Seeing a small latency blip on pool-B (p95 +120ms). Dropping traffic to 5% on canary while we observe.

Liam: Noted. Starting KV cache prewarm and running a 2m synthetic load focused on long-context sequences.

deploy-bot: routing updated: canary -> 5% traffic. Canary deployment remains v2.4.1-canary.

Maya K: Decision criteria recap:
- Abort & rollback if error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m
- Abort & rollback if p95 exceeds baseline +300ms sustained for 5m
- Minor spikes ok for <3m, ops discretion
We need 15m stable at target traffic to proceed with rollout to 50%.

Sara: Release notes are tagged and QA signoff attached in the release doc.

Liam: I'll give green if metrics stable for 15m. If we hit any of the thresholds, we'll rollback immediately.

Tom: Confirming embed pin applied for Dedicated customers. Also flagging that embeddings heavy paths will be excluded from canary (route filter applied).

ops-oncall: Holding oncall actively for +1h. If I see sustained fail criteria I'll run the rollback command above. :white_check_mark:

Maya K: Thanks all. We'll monitor and reconvene in 20m for a go/no-go update. :rocket:
